integrity: Proof uses finite-circle quadratic polarization and a cycle Green identity; finite exact-arithmetic verification is corroborative only. No independent validation has been performed. The unweighted-cycle endpoint is acknowledged as previous work.
scientific_limitations: Finite real weighted cycles with one positive edge length not exceeding one and uniform vertex law; arbitrary weights, other measures, higher moments and all equality cases are not classified. Unindexed overlapping literature remains possible.
title: Exact parity law for Lipschitz variance on cycles with one shortened edge
